implementation_error_history.controlled_resolution: The unchanged prospectively locked source payload was retransmitted in fifteen fixed-length chunks and verified by exact total length, SHA-256 and gzip CRC before source materialization.

single_core_ablation.exact_source_delta: minimum_rr <= rr removed from the otherwise unchanged nearest-pivot selector

dominant_failure_factor: The common spot-perpetual acceptance and FVG retest logic did not make fresh four-hour range boundaries reliable continuation levels. Both four-hour trades stopped almost immediately. Removing target skipping repaired the eight-hour trade but could not repair direction quality, frequency or source breadth.
invalid_generalizations: A high nominal reward-to-risk target chosen by skipping closer liquidity is not evidence of a probable objective.
Common spot-perpetual acceptance beyond any mechanically generated four-hour boundary is not sufficient evidence of continuation.
One profitable eight-hour breakout is not enough to promote or generalize the candidate.
valid_components: The nearest intact pre-event pivot was a better natural objective for the eight-hour breakout and was reached one minute after entry.
The common spot-perpetual acceptance state remained causally stable when only target selection changed.
Level-source component runs exposed the entire negative contribution of the four-hour levels.
The one-line ablation preserved all market-state, entry, invalidation, cost and risk rules.
next_design_implication: Retain common spot-perpetual accepted breakout and nearest intact pivot targeting, but replace mechanically fresh four-hour boundaries with mature, untouched swing-liquidity levels whose existence and age predate the event. Level maturity is a different market-structure hypothesis and requires a new prospective candidate.
